Kevin Burge

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 24, Dallas County, Texas · Challenger

Cybersecurity manager at Caterpillar; former defense intelligence officer; U.S. Marine Corps veteran

Kevin Burge is a Marine Corps veteran and intelligence professional who says he served three overseas combat tours and worked as an advisor in the White House Situation Room. He finished first in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Texas' 24th Congressional District with 48.0% of the vote, then beat TJ Ware in the May 26, 2026 runoff. In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Republican incumbent Beth Van Duyne.

Where Burge stands

Taxes
Supports tax relief for households earning under $400,000 and says he will work to lower taxes.
Tariffs and inflation
Proposes rolling back President Trump's tariffs to ease inflation and restoring Congress's authority over tariffs. Supports protecting the Federal Reserve's independence.
Health care
Says he will vote to restore and expand Affordable Care Act subsidies. Supports moving toward an optional universal health coverage system that separates coverage from employment and does not ban private insurance.
Immigration and national security
Lists immigration reform and protecting civil liberties in his campaign platform. Calls for ending the war in Iran.
Housing and cost of living
Proposes fast-tracking funding for affordable housing, cracking down on corporate landlords, banning unfair AI pricing software, and raising the federal minimum wage.
Education and child care
Proposes expanding Head Start, including universal pre-K access for every child in the district. Supports more grants for technical skills training and tuition-free public college and trade education.
Executive power
Says reining in President Trump's executive power would be one of his priorities if elected.

Background

  • U.S. Marine Corps Reserve, 2003–2011; campaign says he deployed twice to Iraq and once to Afghanistan
  • Defense intelligence officer; says he advised in the White House Situation Room
  • Cybersecurity manager, Caterpillar
  • Graduate degree, North Carolina State University
  • Democratic nominee for U.S. House, Texas District 24, 2026 (primary March 3, runoff May 26)
  • No elected offices held
